name: Data Analyzer: Upload a dictionary, save it, then fetch it back by its ID
objective: Shows the two-step workflow works: a dictionary is parsed and saved, and the saved program can be retrieved with matching details.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in returning a canned, made-up program record. The test is skipped if the service is unavailable (503).

steps.action: Upload a dictionary CSV with save_program true and a program name
steps.expected: HTTP 200 (no 'service unavailable' skip any more); reply has program id, name, field and rule counts. program_id is integration-test-prog-001.

steps.action: Fetch the program by the returned ID
steps.expected: HTTP 200; same program_id, name 20251202-120000-PatientIntake, 8 fields (equal to the upload reply), schema and generated code present; the store was asked for exactly that ID.

name: Data Analyzer: Upload a dictionary in preview mode (not saved) tells the parser not to save
objective: Shows the preview option works: HTTP 200, the program creator is called with save=False and the API itself never writes to the program database.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in returning a canned, made-up program record, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Upload a dictionary CSV with save_program false
steps.expected: HTTP 200, program_id temp-preview-001; parser called with save=False; the stand-in's save method is never called.

name: Data Analyzer: REDCap CSV dictionary is accepted and its text reaches the parser
objective: Shows a CSV dictionary is parsed successfully (using a stand-in result): HTTP 200, the right program id, format and field count, and the parser receives the uploaded text unchanged.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in returning a canned, made-up program record, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Upload the REDCap CSV dictionary
steps.expected: HTTP 200; program_id csv-test, format redcap_csv, 8 fields; parser received the exact CSV text.

name: Data Analyzer: FHIR-style JSON dictionary is accepted and its text reaches the parser
objective: Shows a JSON dictionary is parsed successfully (using a stand-in result): HTTP 200, the right program id, format and field count, and the parser receives the uploaded text unchanged.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in returning a canned, made-up program record, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Upload the FHIR-style JSON dictionary
steps.expected: HTTP 200; program_id json-test, format fhir_json, 3 fields; parser received the exact JSON text.

name: Data Analyzer: Excel file as a dictionary is rejected with 400 and a clear message
objective: Shows that an unsupported dictionary format is refused with an explanation.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Upload a file named dict.xlsx as the dictionary.
steps.expected: HTTP 400 and the message contains 'Unsupported file format'.

name: Data Analyzer: Health check reports 'degraded' when a core service is down and 'healthy' when both are up
objective: Shows the health status honestly reflects missing services. Both states are forced with stand-ins, so the check no longer depends on how this machine is configured.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Ask for health with dictionary storage missing
steps.expected: HTTP 200, status 'degraded', services.program_manager false.

steps.action: Ask for health with both core services present
steps.expected: HTTP 200, status 'healthy', services.program_manager true.

name: Data Analyzer: Dictionary upload returns 503 when dictionary storage is unavailable

steps.action: Upload a made-up dictionary CSV.
steps.expected: HTTP 503 and the message contains 'service not available'.

name: Data Analyzer: Dictionary fetch returns 503 when dictionary storage is unavailable
objective: Shows a clear 'service not available' answer on retrieval.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called. Dictionary storage is switched off.

steps.action: Request /api/v1/dictionary/test-id.
steps.expected: HTTP 503 and the message contains 'service not available'.

name: Data Analyzer: Five health checks sent at the same time all succeed
objective: Shows the health check keeps working when several requests arrive together. The five requests are now sent from five threads at once (previously they were sent one after another).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Send five health checks from five threads at once
steps.expected: Five replies, every one HTTP 200 with status 'healthy' or 'degraded'.

name: Data Analyzer: Three dictionary fetches sent at the same time give identical results
objective: Shows simultaneous retrievals of one dictionary all succeed with the same content. The three requests are now sent from three threads at once, and only HTTP 200 is accepted.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in returning a canned, made-up program record.

steps.action: Fetch the same dictionary ID from three threads at once
steps.expected: Statuses are 200, 200, 200; all three bodies are identical with program_id concurrent-test; the store was asked three times.

name: Data Analyzer: A 10,000-field dictionary is accepted and handed to the parser in full
objective: Shows a large (but under the size limit) dictionary upload gets HTTP 200 and that all 10,000 rows reach the parser untruncated. The AI step is replaced by a stand-in, so no AI model is called.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in returning a canned, made-up program record, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Upload a dictionary CSV with 10,000 made-up field rows
steps.expected: HTTP 200 with 10000 fields extracted; the parser received the full text (10,000 data lines).

name: Data Analyzer: An empty dictionary file gives HTTP 500 with a fixed error message
objective: Shows that when processing an empty dictionary fails, the API returns a controlled error with a generic message rather than success.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in where stated, so no AI model is called. Dictionary storage is set to fail with 'No fields could be extracted'.

steps.action: Upload an empty dictionary file.
steps.expected: HTTP 500 exactly, and the error text is exactly 'Dictionary parsing failed.'. The failure comes from the stand-in, so this tests error handling, not the real parser.

name: Data Analyzer: The key keeps working on a protected address across three requests
objective: Shows the API key is accepted every time on a protected address (the health check needs no key, so it could not prove this). The same address without the key is refused.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in that finds nothing, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Fetch an unknown dictionary ID three times with the key
steps.expected: Each reply is HTTP 404 (the key was accepted and the handler ran); the store was asked three times.

steps.action: Fetch the same address with no key
steps.expected: HTTP 401.

name: Data Analyzer: Public health check works; protected dictionary fetch needs the key
objective: Shows public and protected addresses behave differently: health works with no key, the dictionary address answers exactly 404 with the key (nothing stored) and 401 without it.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in that finds nothing, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Ask for health with no key
steps.expected: HTTP 200.

steps.action: Fetch an unknown dictionary with the key
steps.expected: HTTP 404.

steps.action: Fetch the same address with no key
steps.expected: HTTP 401.

name: Data Analyzer: Valid, then wrong, then valid key behave correctly in sequence
objective: Shows that a rejected key does not affect later requests with the right key.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured; the application is reloaded for this group of tests. Dictionary storage is replaced by a stand-in that finds nothing, so no AI model is called.

steps.action: Fetch an unknown dictionary with the right key
steps.expected: HTTP 404 (key accepted).

steps.action: Fetch with a wrong key
steps.expected: HTTP 403.

steps.action: Fetch with the right key again
steps.expected: HTTP 404 (key accepted again).
